description: Two independent macro knobs, each with an input that takes the knob over, a gain and offset on that input, and a range control scaling what comes out

params.text: Sets that half's value, -10V to 10V; a cable in that half's input takes this knob over and moves it
Scales that half's output, 0 to 10, taken together with the range CV
Attenuverts that half's range CV before it scales the output
Scales that half's input before it becomes the value, -2 to 2 times
Shifts that half's input after the gain, -10V to 10V
Sets that half's value, -10V to 10V; a cable in that half's input takes this knob over and moves it
Scales that half's output, 0 to 10, taken together with the range CV
Attenuverts that half's range CV before it scales the output
Scales that half's input before it becomes the value, -2 to 2 times
Shifts that half's input after the gain, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: Replaces that half's knob, through its gain and offset trimmers; the knob follows what arrives here
Scales that half's output together with the range knob, 0-10V for none to all of it; with nothing patched it counts as 10V

outputs.text: That half's value scaled by the range setting, clamped to -10 to 10V

notes: a range CV jack left empty counts as 10V, so the range knob alone sets the output level until something is patched there

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
